verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS compliance platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no bulk or full-account export, no open-format download, and no offboarding or data-portability process. The closest item is API access to cases, alerts and risks for use in your own case management system. That is a developer building block for integration, not a documented capability to export all of your data and leave.
